MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 25
   D. 5

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 55

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 6

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 20

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 14

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 36

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

21. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 11

22. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
